title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 031
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute copy and document variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Two overlapping document sheets with two short text bars on the front page
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants duplicated pages and the front sheet visibly carries text bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for blank or dashed copy icons when the front page text bars should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two stacked pages and places short text bars on the front sheet.

items.depicts_observation: Two overlapping square document panels with a blank front sheet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants duplicated page panels without text lines or dashed edges.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the text bar or dashed selection variants when the front sheet should stay blank.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the overlapping page stack but removes the text bars from the front panel.

items.depicts_observation: Square document panel with a dashed duplicate frame floating at the upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a copy symbol that emphasizes a dashed duplicate frame instead of stacked sheets.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the overlapping page copies when the dashed outer frame is the main cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the rear sheet with a dashed frame floating around the upper right corner.

items.depicts_observation: Single document sheet with two short horizontal text bars centered inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants one plain document page with two centered text bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for folded corner documents when the top edge should stay flat and plain.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the plainest single page with two centered text bars and no folded corner.

items.depicts_observation: Document sheet with a folded top right corner one dot and one short text bar
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a single page with a visible folded corner and mixed line dot marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain page when the folded corner should remain part of the form.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a folded top corner plus one dot and one short line inside the page.
